cat > /tmp/opencode/cdp.mjs <<'EOF'
const r=await fetch('http://localhost:9222/json/list'); const pages=await r.json(); const p=pages.find(x=>x.type==='page'&&x.url.includes('4173')); const ws=new WebSocket(p.webSocketDebuggerUrl); let id=0; const pending=new Map(); ws.onmessage=e=>{const m=JSON.parse(e.data);if(m.id&&pending.has(m.id)){pending.get(m.id)(m);pending.delete(m.id)}}; await new Promise((ok,err)=>{ws.onopen=ok;ws.onerror=err}); const call=(method,params={})=>new Promise(resolve=>{const n=++id;pending.set(n,resolve);ws.send(JSON.stringify({id:n,method,params}))}); await call('Runtime.enable'); let x=await call('Runtime.evaluate',{expression:"document.querySelector('#start').click(); document.querySelector('#overlay').classList.add('hidden'); document.querySelector('#hud').style.display='block'; true",awaitPromise:true}); console.log('start',x.result?.result); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1500)); let s=await call('Page.captureScreenshot',{format:'jpeg',quality:80}); const fs=await import('node:fs/promises'); await fs.writeFile('/tmp/opencode/game.jpg',Buffer.from(s.result.data,'base64')); const errors=await call('Runtime.evaluate',{expression:"({err:document.body.innerText.includes('Error'), task:document.querySelector('#task').textContent})"});console.log(errors.result.result);ws.close();
EOF
node /tmp/opencode/cdp.mjs
